name: harbor
description: The harbor for all of your servers and web apps.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.account:recovery: npm run build -w server && node server/dist/cli.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w server && node --test --test-concurrency=1 server/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run licenses:check
